svg.text: Everyday English - Life phrases
I could use a hand with
this.
MEANING
A natural, mildly indirect way to say you would
appreciate some help.
IN CONTEXT
I could use a hand with these boxes, if you
have a minute.
USAGE NOTE
Could use expresses a current need or wish; a
hand means help. Add a specific task so the
other person knows what to do.
CONVERSATION
A: You look busy. Everything okay?
B: I could use a hand with this. Could you help
set up the chairs?
A: Of course. Where should they go?
B: Six rows facing the stage would be great,
thanks.
YOUR TURN
Make a friendly request for help, adding a
specific task and an easy way to respond.
